skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Executor's attire during canonization.
Custom-made by the Curia and designed by the cardinals, thoroughly unique in more ways than one.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
One's clothing represents one's hopes and expectations, but does not change the essence of the wearer.
Executor must adapt to his new role. Saint Federico will learn the weight of his attire.

skins.name: Allmind As One
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Allmind As One. A possibility derived from when Executor connected to the Law: connected consciousnesses tend towards unity, all to achieve one goal. Exsequi. Exsequi. Exsequi.
skins.usage: One of Executor the Ex Foedere's casual outfits.
skins.quote: He sees a Laterano: united, efficient, serene. Under absolute rationality, the individual is but a gear in the machine, and he is its core.

skins.name: The Train Runner
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/The Train Runner. As a child, dressed in pristine clothes, he too chased the shadows of trains out of curiosity. Now, stepping onto exotic platforms, his goals are far clearer.
skins.usage: One of Executor the Ex Foedere's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Though often the mysteries of fate and the journey ahead are unknown, his resolve to unveil time's secrets and uncover the truth has never wavered.
